title: Treetop Terrace, Gated! 3 mi. to Broadway+Stadium!
description:
Gorgeous 2 bedroom 2 1/2 bath townhouse- larger corner unit at Trinity Heights -1507 sq ft! Rooftop terrace with shade sail and waterproof cushions - the perfect place to lounge.  Sleeps 8 with 2 queens in each bedroom, plus 2 twin beds in an extra area (daybed + trundle bed).   Smart TVs in each bedroom and living room.  Three thermostats.  Backyard area with corn hole.  One block from East Nashville Beer Works! Keypad entry and gated complex.  40% off monthly rental.

The space
3 miles to Nissan Stadium, 3 miles to downtown 2nd Avenue, 2.5 miles from Topgolf, 9 miles to the Opry area/water park, and close to multiple Nashville breweries.  Gated community! Front door keypad entry.

The rooftop terrace is the perfect place to lounge and sip a sweet tea or your favorite beverage!  

Beautiful, serene townhome with everything you could want for a fabulous Nashville stay.  Hang your hat here for your Southern Stay, and make it your home away from home!

Guest access
Gated community.  Entire home - keypad entry with code provided the day before arrival.

Other things to note
Please review house manual upon arrival (located on kitchen bar), for details and check-out instructions. Thank you!
